stoppingRule: Run one native recovery trial per case and adapter. Require complete 2,000-task snapshots, writer-only TCP outage, independent reader convergence and genuine SIGKILL recovery for 1,000 writes. Jazz must preserve full local state across restart while its native deferred edge-durable snapshot still contains the original values; after reconnect, complete local, edge-durable and independent reader snapshots must match. Reopen receives only the original configuration/store. Missing global queue telemetry stays unavailable. Syncular checks the shared-controller regression. This smoke makes no performance comparison.
